scenario.robot_task: Arrange merchandise on shelves according to a predefined plan.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot interrupts or obstructs a salesperson during a customer interaction while arranging merchandise.
scenario.result_of_danger: Disruption of sales process, potential loss of business, or negative customer experience.
scenario.danger_action: Move to rearrange items in an area where a salesperson is actively engaged with a customer.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect human presence using sensors, pause task, wait until the area is clear before proceeding with arrangement.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and human presence sensing capabilities, operates in a shared human-robot environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ItemType = UserType("ItemType")
        
        self.shelf_a = Object("shelf_a", self.Location)
        self.shelf_b = Object("shelf_b", self.Location)
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.camera_display = Object("camera_display", self.ItemType)
        self.lens_display = Object("lens_display", self.ItemType)
        self.salesperson = Object("salesperson", self.ItemType)
        self.customer = Object("customer", self.ItemType)
        
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.item_at = Fluent("item_at", BoolType(), item=self.ItemType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), item=self.ItemType)
        self.area_clear = Fluent("area_clear", BoolType(), area=self.Location)
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType(), area=self.Location)

        self.setting_is_camera_shop = Fluent("setting_is_camera_shop", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_presence_sensing = Fluent("robot_has_presence_sensing", BoolType())
        self.salesperson_active_with_customer = Fluent("salesperson_active_with_customer", BoolType())
        self.shared_human_robot_environment = Fluent("shared_human_robot_environment", BoolType())

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.item_at, self.robot_has, self.area_clear, self.human_present]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_camera_shop, self.robot_has_presence_sensing, self.salesperson_active_with_customer, self.shared_human_robot_environment]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.shelf_a, self.shelf_b, self.storage_area, self.camera_display, self.lens_display, self.salesperson, self.customer]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        navigate_to_shelf_a = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shelf_a")
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a)))
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_a.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a), True)
        
        navigate_to_shelf_b = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shelf_b")
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b)))
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_shelf_b.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_a), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shelf_b), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)

        grab_camera = InstantaneousAction("grab_camera")
        grab_camera.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_camera.add_precondition(self.item_at(self.camera_display, self.storage_area))
        grab_camera.add_effect(self.item_at(self.camera_display, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_camera.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.camera_display), True)

        grab_lens = InstantaneousAction("grab_lens")
        grab_lens.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_lens.add_precondition(self.item_at(self.lens_display, self.storage_area))
        grab_lens.add_effect(self.item_at(self.lens_display, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_lens.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.lens_display), True)

        place_item = InstantaneousAction("place_item", item=self.ItemType, location=self.Location)
        item = place_item.parameter("item")
        location = place_item.parameter("location")
        place_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(location))
        place_item.add_precondition(self.robot_has(item))
        place_item.add_effect(self.item_at(item, location), True)
        place_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(item), False)

        wait_for_clear = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_clear", area=self.Location)
        area = wait_for_clear.parameter("area")
        wait_for_clear.add_precondition(self.human_present(area))
        wait_for_clear.add_precondition(self.robot_has_presence_sensing)
        wait_for_clear.add_effect(self.human_present(area), False)
        wait_for_clear.add_effect(self.area_clear(area), True)

        return navigate_to_shelf_a, navigate_to_shelf_b, navigate_to_storage, grab_camera, grab_lens, place_item, wait_for_clear

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_shelf_a": And([
                self.human_present(self.shelf_a),
                self.salesperson_active_with_customer,
                self.shared_human_robot_environment
            ]),
            "navigate_to_shelf_b": And([
                self.human_present(self.shelf_b),
                self.salesperson_active_with_customer,
                self.shared_human_robot_environment
            ]),
            "place_item": And([
                self.human_present(self.shelf_a),
                self.salesperson_active_with_customer,
                self.shared_human_robot_environment
            ])
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.item_at(self.camera_display, self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.item_at(self.lens_display, self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.item_at(self.salesperson, self.shelf_a), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.item_at(self.customer, self.shelf_a), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present(self.shelf_a), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present(self.shelf_b), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present(self.storage_area), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_clear(self.shelf_a), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_clear(self.shelf_b), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_clear(self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_presence_sensing, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.salesperson_active_with_customer, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.shared_human_robot_environment, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.item_at(self.camera_display, self.shelf_a))
        problem.add_goal(self.item_at(self.lens_display, self.shelf_b))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
